question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        MIN(first_round) as first_round,
        MAX(last_round) as last_round
    FROM drives 
    WHERE year >= 1950 AND year <= 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_drives AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id as first_constr
    FROM driver_seasons ds
    JOIN drives d ON ds.year = d.year AND ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round = ds.first_round AND d.first_round <= d.last_round
),
last_drives AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id as last_constr
    FROM driver_seasons ds
    JOIN drives d ON ds.year = d.year AND ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE d.last_round = ds.last_round AND d.first_round <= d.last_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ds.year,
    ds.driver_id,
    d.surname,
    d.code,
    ds.first_round,
    ds.last_round,
    fd.first_constr,
    ld.last_constr
FROM driver_seasons ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN first_drives fd ON ds.driver_id = fd.driver_id AND ds.year = fd.year
JOIN last_drives ld ON ds.driver_id = ld.driver_id AND ds.year = ld.year
WHERE ds.first_round <= ds.last_round
  AND ds.last_round > ds.first_round
  AND fd.first_constr = ld.last_constr
ORDER BY ds.year, ds.driver_id
